implementation.transaction_boundary: Job creation, idempotency record, JOB_QUEUED outbox event and audit row are committed in one SQLite transaction; failures roll back the whole command.
implementation.durable_state: jobs, job_attempts, progress_json, lease timestamps, resource leases and outbox_events are read from SQLite by a newly constructed Database/JobService instance.
implementation.restart_reconciliation: A fresh claim runs reconciliation before selecting work; explicit reconciliation marks expired CLAIMED/RUNNING attempts ORPHANED, requeues retryable jobs and releases resource leases.
implementation.crash_rehearsal: A subprocess commits create/claim/heartbeat and exits via os._exit(17). The parent then verifies persisted job progress, attempt history, outbox events, redacted lease_token and resource-lease release after the simulated clock advances 61 seconds.
